Package com.nexuslink.ui.util

Class JsonView

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.ui.util.JsonView
public final class JsonView extends Object
A themed, syntax-highlighting JSON viewer/editor built on a RichTextFX CodeArea. Keys, strings, numbers, booleans, null and punctuation each get their own .json-* style class (see theme-base.css), so documents are readable in both dark and light themes.

    • area

      public static org.fxmisc.richtext.CodeArea area(boolean editable)
      Creates a CodeArea wired for JSON highlighting. Highlighting refreshes on every edit.

    • setText

      public static void setText(org.fxmisc.richtext.CodeArea area, String text)
      Replaces the content and re-highlights it.

    • plainArea

      public static org.fxmisc.richtext.CodeArea plainArea(boolean editable)
      A CodeArea styled for JSON but WITHOUT the auto-highlight listener — the caller decides when (and whether) to highlight, via setSmart(org.fxmisc.richtext.CodeArea, java.lang.String). Use this where the same area also shows non-JSON content (XML, hex dumps, plain text).

    • setSmart

      public static void setSmart(org.fxmisc.richtext.CodeArea area, String text)
      Sets the text and highlights it as JSON only when it looks like JSON (first non-space char is &#123; or [); otherwise renders it as plain text. Safe for a viewer that also shows XML / hex / error messages.
